description: Publish a text-only post on Threads. Supports optional link attachment, poll, GIF, topic tag, and quote post.

crossreshare_to_ig.description: Also share this post to the user's linked Instagram account as a Story

crossreshare_to_ig_dark_mode.description: Cross-share to Instagram Stories in dark mode

enable_reply_approvals.description: Require replies to be approved before they're published. Not compatible with ghost posts.

gif_id.description: GIF ID from GIPHY (id field from GIPHY's API response). GIPHY is currently the only supported GIF provider (Tenor was sunset March 31, 2026).

is_ghost_post.description: Create a ghost post (auto-archived after 24h). Text-only, and per Meta's docs the only other feature supported alongside it is is_spoiler — do not combine with polls, GIFs, links, topic tags, location, reply approvals, or cross-sharing. Ghost posts also cannot be used to reply to a post.

link_attachment.description: URL to attach as a link preview card (max 5 links per post)

poll_options.description: Poll options (2-4 choices, each 1-25 characters). Creates a poll attachment.

quote_post_id.description: ID of a post to quote

spoiler_ranges.description: Up to 10 exact spoiler ranges within text. If omitted and is_spoiler=true, the entire text is marked as a spoiler.

topic_tag.description: Topic tag for the post (1-50 chars, no periods or ampersands)

name: threads_publish_text
